keyVerseDR: "...they are last that shall be first: and they are first that shall be last." (Lk 13:30)

level1.title: The Narrow Door
level1.story: Someone asked, "Will only a few be saved?" Jesus said, "Try hard to enter through the narrow gate." People will come from everywhere to God's feast.
level1.keyLine: I will choose the good way.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What kind of door did Jesus talk about?
What good choice can you make?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me walk the narrow way. Amen.

activity.title: The narrow gate
activity.intro: Find the narrow way to God's kingdom.

level2.title: Strive for the Narrow Gate
level2.story: As Jesus traveled toward Jerusalem, someone asked, "Lord, are they few that are saved?" Jesus said, "Strive to enter by the narrow gate." He said that once the master shuts the door, some will knock and say, "Lord, open to us," but He will say, "I know you not." People will come from the east and the west, the north and the south, and sit down in the kingdom of God. "And behold, they are last that shall be first, and they are first that shall be last."
level2.keyLine: They are last that shall be first.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Is it enough to just know about Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me strive for heaven. Amen.

activity.title: Secret message
activity.intro: Use the code to find Jesus' words.

art.mainBrief: Narrow door open with light; people from all nations
